row.title: AUDIENCE-1: every system builds a returning audience
row.body: Shared engine seed/scripts/audience.py measures supply, promotion, hook, attention and return daily; feed requests and aggregator subscriber counts are recorded by recordFeed; hook events via window.ultrastableEvent; breaches file Q-AUD items, stale sections run their producer, targets ratchet.
